# temps_notification_provider_telegram (Resource)

A Telegram notification provider: a bot posts alerts to a chat, group or channel. Temps never returns the provider's credentials, so changes made to them outside Terraform are not detected. Reading a provider of another kind is an error.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `notification_providers:read`, `notification_providers:create`, `notification_providers:write`, `notification_providers:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_notification_provider_telegram" "ops" {
  name              = "Ops group"
  bot_token         = var.telegram_bot_token
  chat_id           = "-1001234567890"
  message_thread_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Bot token from @BotFather, `123456789:AA...`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `chat_id` (String) Chat to post to: a numeric user, group or channel ID (`-100...` for supergroups and channels) or a public `@channelusername`.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Send notifications through the provider.
- `message_thread_id` (Number) Forum topic to post in, for groups with topics.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>. Temps never returns the bot token, so set it in configuration again after importing.
terraform import temps_notification_provider_telegram.ops 7
```
